summary: Iteration 6 — Payment page + Receipt-only changes verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). All 6 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) Payment page NO LONGER shows any 'Kekurangan' or 'Pembayaran kurang' text — DOM scans on empty-cash and underpaid states both returned false for both strings. (2) Kembalian row shows 'Rp 0' when underpaid (color green as per code, colors.brand). (3) Suggestion nominals render as 2 rows of 4 buttons for total Rp 6.000: [quick-6000, quick-7000, quick-8000, quick-9000] top row (base+0/+1000/+2000/+3000) and [quick-10000, quick-25000, quick-50000, quick-100000] bottom row (ceilTo 10k/25k/50k/100k, deduped, sorted). All 8 buttons visible, not cut off. testID pattern is 'quick-<numeric_value>' as spec. Tapping quick-6000 sets exact cash Rp 6.000 (change Rp 0); tapping quick-100000 sets Rp 100.000 (change Rp 94.000). (4) Underpayment (cash=Rp 1.000, total=Rp 6.000): confirm button stays enabled with label 'Simpan (Bayar Sebagian)', POST /api/transactions succeeded, receipt saved (#533F9C) with cash_paid=1000, change=0. (5) Receipt on underpaid shows the dashed 'PEMBAYARAN KURANG' box at TOP with 'Rp 5.000' (testID receipt-unpaid visible=True, body contains 'PEMBAYARAN KURANG'). (6) Fully-paid path (cash=Rp 6.000): change 'Rp 0' green, label 'Selesaikan Transaksi', receipt saved (#75E273), receipt-unpaid NOT visible, body does NOT contain 'PEMBAYARAN KURANG'. Overpaid (Rp 100.000): change Rp 94.000, receipt shows Tunai Rp 100.000 / Kembali Rp 94.000, no PEMBAYARAN KURANG block. Regression: cart step (Daftar Belanja) intact, numpad-1/2/…/000/back all work, Uang Pas correctly removed. Two harmless legacy warnings still present (props.pointerEvents deprecated, useNativeDriver not supported) — unrelated to this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: checkout.tsx: on the payment step there is no visual affordance now for underpayment (Kembalian just shows Rp 0). The only cue is the confirm button label change to 'Simpan (Bayar Sebagian)'. This matches the explicit user request (banner removed intentionally), noting for future UX consideration.

confirmPay stores cash_paid as the raw underpaid amount and change=Math.max(0,change)=0, which is correct for a partial payment; consider adding an explicit paid status flag on Transaction if future reporting must distinguish partial vs. full payments (backend currently accepts it without differentiation).

receipt.ts and ReceiptPreview.tsx both compute shortfall=max(0, total-cash_paid). Kept consistent between preview and printed thermal text — verified both render 'PEMBAYARAN KURANG' only when shortfall>0.
seed_data_creation: Two real transactions were created against the live backend during verification: underpaid (#533F9C, cash=1.000, total=6.000, PEMBAYARAN KURANG=Rp 5.000) and overpaid (#75E273, cash=100.000, total=6.000, change=94.000). Product used: '1 mitubaby tisu basah'. Main agent may delete these test transactions if the transaction log must remain clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach payment on mobile viewport 390x844: tap cari-barang-button -> fill cari-input with product name -> tap a cari-row-* -> tap a cari-var-* if variation modal appears (otherwise item is added directly) -> close cari (cari-done or Escape) -> tap bayar-button on main tab (this routes to /checkout?step=pay directly, skipping the Daftar Belanja step). On payment step, quick buttons use testID='quick-<numeric_value>' e.g. quick-6000, quick-100000 (NOT the rupiah-formatted string that iteration 5 used). Numpad: numpad-0..9, numpad-000, numpad-back. Confirm: checkout-confirm-button. After save, receipt-unpaid testID appears only when total>cash_paid.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 6 acceptance criteria from the iteration 6 review request verified via UI + real backend POST /api/transactions.
